name: @customerio/jist
description: Cross-platform JSON template renderer — web custom element. Renders Jist template trees into native DOM.

scripts.build:wasm: cd ../core/jist-core && cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir ../../web/src/wasm --out-name jist_core ../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/jist_core.wasm && (wasm-opt -Oz --enable-bulk-memory --enable-nontrapping-float-to-int --strip-debug --strip-producers ../../web/src/wasm/jist_core_bg.wasm -o ../../web/src/wasm/jist_core_bg.wasm || echo 'wasm-opt not installed — shipping unoptimized wasm')

author: Customer.io (https://customer.io)
